status: contract-fixed; R1 compile and parity not started

target.role: downstream consumer/integration target; not AI crate implementation repository

backend.device: explicit Flex CPU with first-order autodiff
backend.production_toolchain: AI crate toolchain and MSRV declared in banto-ai; downstream integration additionally verifies banto-industrial pinned 1.98.1

model.target: separate float32-le [B,3,32]; never part of inference request
model.context_scale: population std (correction=0), max(std, profile context_floor32), past context only
model.attention_mask: causal time mask, -infinity logits; full series mask
model.python_Forecast_mean: context center, not expected future quantity
model.nondifferentiable_boundary: R2 must compare reference maximum/pinball tie gradients, not assume identical subgradient

reference_selection: lowest fixed fold 0, not selected by performance; first and last saved train batches only for R1; no test re-evaluation

optimizer.weight_decay_parameters: all named parameters including biases and layernorm; buffers excluded
optimizer.state: named first/second moments and per-parameter update counters; bias correction and decoupled decay

package.manifest: JSON UTF-8 plus immutable SHA256 closure
package.tensors: named little-endian row-major bytes, shape/dtype/offset/length/SHA256; checked arithmetic, no overlap/out-of-range/duplicate/unlisted tensor
package.linear_layout: canonical PyTorch [out,in]; transpose model/gradient/moments together if backend [in,out]
package.python_rng: opaque reference bytes, not a portable Rust generator; replay actual saved schedule; no dropout draws

tolerance.rule: each element abs(Rust-ref)<=atol+rtol*abs(ref), unless specified; fixed before Rust outputs; failure stops and records, no post hoc widening
tolerance.discrete: exact masks, indices, shape, support, time, identity, serialization roundtrip, alarm state on identical score stream
tolerance.same_backend_resume: continuous 8 versus 4+restore+4: byte-exact parameters/moments/counters/outputs with fixed backend/threads/schedule
tolerance.alarm_boundary: report numeric threshold crossing disagreements; do not add epsilon or change eligibility

adapter.identity: application binding_key -> external_name; StableTagId is audit metadata, not binding identity
adapter.quality: Good plus finite Some(v) required; Stale/Bad/Unknown/null/unresolved invalid; never missing->0
adapter.value_source: first production adapter admits Real with Configured only; simulation/derived/internal/db/computed require separately versioned model/data policy, not silent mixing
adapter.history: raw samples only; chart min/max envelopes are not training quantities; historical quality/source availability not reconstructible from RawRow alone
adapter.historical_admission: unknown quality/availability remains unknown; training blocked until a separate explicit accepted-input contract or quality+availability sidecar exists
adapter.time: source t and receiver-observed available_at distinct; only both <= issuance; clock domains explicit; history ptime_ms not assumed source t; CARE file-local timestamps not UTC
adapter.freshness: same unchanged snapshot is not a new observation; explicit cadence/aggregation/freshness contract required before live buffering; no forward fill by watch polling
adapter.lifecycle: catalog unit/scaling/name or run_id generation changes split/reset context; no cross-asset or cross-file interpolation
adapter.boundary: training bounded worker/sidecar, independent from PLC collection/real-time paths and UI thread; no control writes
adapter.ownership: application DTO conversion, acquisition/history and job hosting/activation policy belong to banto-industrial; portable AI training/inference/checkpoint belong to banto-ai

gates.scope: crate at tyaro/banto-ai:crates/banto-ai (isolated build first), resolve exact backend, lock and dependency license inventory, compile CPU; saved fold0 weights and two train batches, artificial constant/zero/floor/nonfinite/mask/quantile cases
gates.stop: resource overrun, compile/link/toolchain failures or any parity gate fail; no model tuning

gates.scope: loss/backward/clip/AdamW, artificial tie/clip/decay fixtures and train-prefix only 8 updates; continuous8 vs4+restore4; include importing mature step4096 moments
gates.stop: no CARE test forward/evaluation; freeze fixture before new training

gates.scope: separately fixed finite Rust training+evaluation comparison after R1/R2, preserve original scientific conditions; port numerical differences reported
banto-industrial consumes pinned banto-ai crate; adapter and job/model integration compile with downstream pinned toolchain; Windows OS-specific checks separately

supersedes.change: repository ownership and dependency direction only; scientific/numerical contract unchanged

responsibility: portable library API and reference CLI
implementation.boundary: application converts its types to portable AI input; core must not import application types

dependency_direction: tyaro/banto-industrial -> version/commit-pinned Rust crate from tyaro/banto-ai; never reverse
